Summary[]

You run into Cristoforo, the mysterious playwright, again. He's on a journey for inspiration to finish his script about the Blessed Maiden, "Fleurdelys." As for Gilberto, he tells you that a Fisalia member has been frequenting Whisperwind Haven, and Echoes have been mysteriously vanishing. Suspecting a connection, you follow the Echoes to investigate further.

Upon reaching the area where Echoes have gone missing, you're attacked by out-of-control Echoes. After quelling them, you notice that they seem to be manipulated, just like the Vitreum Dancers in Ragunna. Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face - Acolyte Phoebe.

Phoebe reveals that she's searching for a missing Echo. You share your findings and she realizes Gilberto's actions are blasphemy against the Sentinel, which calls for a punishment. With shared goals, Phoebe joins your team. Suddenly, the missing Echo appears, fleeing as if bein pursued. You decided to catch up to uncover what's behind its panic.

You finally pin down Gilberto, who is reciitng eerie prayers. On seeing you, he transforms the nearby Echoes into Tacet Discords with a Lycoris flower. A fierce battle ensues. Despite his defeat, Gilberto continues to preach a dark prophecy: Lorelei will command the sea of clouds to engulf Ragunna, sparing only the faithful. Meanwhile, an anomaly at the Nimbus Sanctum suggests Lorelei might also be influenced by a Lycoris. Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive. You head to the sea of clouds alone.

Quest Description
To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...
(Meet up with Zani)
Terminal Call: You're saying the Fisalia family was involved in the incident at the Carnevale rehearsal? Do you have solid evidence?
Zani: Not yet, Mr. Alberto. But the clues we found all lead to Fisalia family member, Gilberto. We will investigate further.
Terminal Call: The Fisalia family... It seems they've run out of patience. This mess has got our honored guest into trouble and given these rats a chance to make their move.
Terminal Call: Please pass on my thanks to our guest for the help. If you find yourselves short of hands or funds, do let me know. I'll be discussing this matter with Director Pacino.
Zani: I will, sir. There's also another sensitive matter. It appears a Priest from the Cathedral of Mercury is involved, so it's highly possible that the Order is aware of this.
Terminal Call: The Order... Let me handle them. You just focus on Gilberto for now. Whatever the case, the Carnevale must be secured.
Terminal Call: This goes beyond the Montelli family. It's also about the faith and hope of countless Ragunnesi.
Zani: Understood.
And that was from...?
Zani: It's from Mr. Alberto. He's the head of Averardo Bank. My superior.
They want you for overtime?
Zani: Not really. It's from Mr. Alberto. He's the head of Averardo Bank. My superior.
Zani: But this doesn't sound like him. He's usually cautious and rarely makes outright promises unless one of the big shots in the family is twisting his arm.
Zani: If the top brass are alarmed, it can only mean that the situation may be...
Extremely bad?
Worse than we thought?
Zani: Hmm, maybe I'm overthinking this. Either way, we've finally got a lead.
Zani: We should search the area. See where Gilberto went.
(Arrive at the designated location)
Zani: Strange, did Gilberto just vanish into thin air?
Zani: I see. A WingrayFlying Echo, that explains it.
Abby: Wingray?

Zani: If Gilberto set up this Wingray as an escape route, it should lead us straight to him.

Cristoforo: Hmm, pardon me, but this lady by your side seems rather familiar...?
Zani: I am Zani. I work at Averardo Bank.

Zani: That's quite fitting. Do I thank you for that?
Cristoforo: Ahh, no need for the formalities. Allow me to re-introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a humble playwright grappling with modern trends. Delighted to meet you.
What are you doing here?
Cristoforo: Actually, I've been working on a script about the Blessed Maiden lately. The well-known Martyred Maiden, Fleurdelys.
Cristoforo: Her brave sacrifice during the Dark Tide saved Ragunna many years ago.
Cristoforo: That sacred maiden perished just as the curtain fell, lying in the center of the sanctuary where spotlights converged. I've longed to capture that tragic scene in a play.
Cristoforo: The script's nearly finished, but something's amiss. With Fleurdelys' home right here before me, I had hoped to find traces of the Blessed Maiden's early life.
Cristoforo: Childhood plays a key role in shaping one's personality, you know.
So, did you find any?
Cristoforo: Sadly, no, I confess I've made zero progress. Most legends of the Blessed Maiden are lost to time. I'm forced to rely on imagination...
Cristoforo: Ahem, nevertheless, the script is finished. I've even asked the children over there to help me rehearse it.
Cristoforo: Here, have a copy. I'm eager for your thoughts.
That's very generous of you.
I'll take a look when I have time.
Zani: Ahem...
Cristoforo: Ah, apologies. I started rambling about my play again. Well, then. What brings you here?
Zani: We're looking for someone. Did you come across anyone from the Fisalia family?

Cristoforo: In fact, I even stared a bit. Old habits die hard. The Fisalias rarely venture beyond city walls, you see.
Zani: So Gilberto did pass through here... Thank you for the information, sir.

Cristoforo: But since that nobleman's arrival, Echoes in the area have been vanishing without a trace.
Cristoforo: Like time lost forever, books forgotten by people, and cherished memories faded away in time's current... Oh, pardon me. My playwright's pen is running away again.

We should look into it.
Zani: Hmm. Echoes started acting strangely when Gilberto showed up, just like what happened in the Carnevele rehearsal... This is no coincidence.
Zani: Mr. Cristoforo, do you know where those Echoes were last seen before they disappeared?
Cristoforo: I'm in the dark as well. However, they might know a thing or two.
Cristoforo: These Echoes are keen to find their friends too. They're not fighters, but they can surely be your guide. Why not take them along?

Zani: Looks like we're dealing with a repeat of the rehearsal incident here... But if Gilberto was behind this, how did he pull it off?

Zani: Petals? They give off a... strange feeling.

Abby: Alright. Let's give it a try. Huh, tastes kinda weird.
Abby: It's not an Echo, or a Tacet Discord... The frequency's coming from a Resonator. A super strong one!

Zani: Yes. Be it the mastermind or another pawn, it's got the Fisalia family written all over it.
Zani: They staged the accident, endangering civilians, and then used it to frame the Montellis.
Zani: What a story. This is definitely headline material. Just think of the leverage the Montelli family could get with this scandal...

Abby: It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?
Abby: Wait... I got an idea...

Phoebe: Livia, Brenno! Any sign of Beppe?
Phoebe: Strange, where could Beppe be...?
Phoebe: Oh... Cut it out, Brenno! Stop that...
Phoebe: Wait, Brenno's right here. Then who's poking me in the back? Beppe, you better have a good expla—
Abby: —Not Beppe. It's me. Abby!
Phoebe: Eek!

Phoebe: Oh, it's you. Pardon me, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Phoebe: I thought you were at Ragunna City. Didn't expect to meet you here. Oh, uhh... Sorry, I don't think we've met.
Zani: Greetings, madam. My name is Zani. Averardo Bank.
Phoebe: I don't think we've met before.
Zani: Well... It's probably because I haven't been to church much... Ahem. Please don't stare at me like that. There are more pressing matters.
Zani: We're investigating the Echo incident from the Carnevale rehearsal at Whisperwind Haven, as requested by the Montelli family. One of our clues led us here.

Phoebe: By the way, have any of you seen an Echo named Beppe? They're about this tall and usually wander around here, but I can't seem to find them anywhere...
Zani: May I?
Zani: Sorry, we didn't see the Echo you mentioned, but we've found clues on their odd behavior. They all point to a member of the Fisalia family, Gilberto.
Zani: He's also caused similar incidents here recently... Echoes went out of control and attacked each other.
Phoebe: The Order has also received reports of missing Echoes in this area. Is it possible that the Fisalia family is involved? I find it really hard to believe.
Phoebe: From what I know, the Fisalia family is deeply respectful of the Divinity. How could they commit such a blasphemous act? The Echoes are gifts from the Sentinel.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Have you seen this before?
Phoebe: A petal? The ritual one? No, wait... this frequency...
Phoebe: Oh, right! I think I saw this flower in the Cathedral of Mercury, and Priest Alessio was wearing it. Wait... Could he be involved with the Fisalia family's plans?
Most certainly.
No, we're still lacking key evidence.
Phoebe: Imperator granted us Echoes, the skies, lands, oceans, and sustenance. To which we should all be grateful and reverent.
Phoebe: I request to join your investigation, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). As a servant of the Sentinel, I simply cannot turn a blind eye to their unholy acts.
What do you think, Zani?

Zani: As long as I'm not treated like a heretic and get kicked out of Rinascita later.
I'm okay with it as well.
Phoebe: Great, it seems we've reached an agreement.
Phoebe: Beppe? Thank the Divinity, you're safe! But what happened to you?
Phoebe: Wait! Beppe... Oh...

Roccia: I plan to go find him. Once I'm in the mist, my frequency will draw the creepies and crawlies away, so you'll be safer here.
Roccia: Just in case, take this to mask your frequency and defend yourself.

I like it!
Roccia: It's easy to use. You want to see the upgraded version? Ta-da! Magnum Fireworks Pistol!
Seems kind of basic...
Roccia: Not your style? I have more where that came from... Ta-da! Celebratory Fireworks Bomb. Wait, that's meant for our dinner. Oops, sorry, Pero grabbed the wrong one. Though, at a pinch, it might prove useful...
Thanks, but guns aren't my thing.
Alright, try this instead... Ta-da! Captain's Parley Saber!
Roccia: Use it to protect yourself. Our troupe will bring you to our base soon and tell you the truth we've uncovered. I'll join you once I find Brant.
I want to see the truth for myself.
Roccia: But the mist is dangerous...
I can hold my own in a fight.
Roccia: No, that's not what I meant. Just... this is going to be risky.
I can't let a child do this alone.
Roccia: Don't worry. I know this place inside out. For a first-timer, though, it might be a bit much.
Roccia: Alright, fine. It's better you see it for yourself. I'll be glad you don't have to fend for yourself alone.
Roccia: See that lighthouse? It's the only safe place in the mist. We'll head there. Brant might have taken shelter there, too.
Roccia: Once we find him, we'll find the truth you're after.
